architecture.discoveryOwnership: candidate discovery semantics remain outside generic Harness: a domain, World integration or Runtime Tool may discover raw paths, records, URLs or already-materialized source identities
architecture.materializationBoundary: raw discovered content is not a WorkingSet pin; domain integration must materialize exact HarnessWorkingViewSource content through the Run privacy boundary and use the returned Harness CAS object digest as resolvedDigest
architecture.selectionOwnership: the Agent remains the owner of successor WorkingSet selection; transient discovery evidence can inform that decision without becoming selected Context automatically
architecture.transientModelView: a durable Provider request may equal the exact committed WorkingView prefix plus ordered exact model projections of Tool Observations already bound in that Provider Call's RunState
architecture.dualSourceIdentity: provider-authored cognition transitions now bind sourceWorkingSetDigest for durable selected Context separately from sourceModelViewDigest for the exact effective Provider-visible view including admitted transient observation overlays

behavior.preMaterializedDiscovery: the Agent first sees insufficient WorkingView A, performs one Runtime search_workspace observation, next sees A plus exact candidate B/C Tool Observation, selects only B, then sees B alone after commit
behavior.runtimeResponseLoss: the same discovery path under Runtime response loss performs one physical workspace.exec and reconciles through existing task.list/task.observe before Agent selection; no duplicate search effect occurs
behavior.rawDiscoveryMaterialization: B/C begin as raw domain records absent from Harness CAS; domain integration materializes them through store_working_view_source before the Tool Receipt is recorded, exposes the actual returned CAS identities in that exact Tool Observation, and the Agent selects the pin it actually observed
behavior.overlayLifetime: transient discovery overlay is keyed by its source WorkingSet in the validated integration; after B commits, the next projected request contains B and not A, C or stale discovery evidence
behavior.prefixFence: a projector that replaces committed WorkingView A is rejected before physical Provider dispatch
behavior.observationProvenanceFence: a projector that preserves A but appends arbitrary unbound user content is rejected before physical Provider dispatch because the suffix is not an exact bound Tool Observation projection
behavior.transitionProvenance: an overlay-backed WorkingSet transition cannot be admitted from a fabricated model-view digest without exact completed Provider request/result evidence
behavior.doctorReplay: a low-level mechanically valid Provider claim containing A plus an invented overlay with no corresponding bound Tool Observation passes Store Doctor but fails Continuity Doctor semantic provenance replay
behavior.casIdentityLesson: HarnessWorkingViewSource semantic digest is distinct from the StoredHarnessObject CAS envelope digest; the first raw-materialization experiment failed when these identities were intentionally conflated, and the corrected path uses the actual materialization return identity

conclusion: P-C1.4 validates a discovery-selection boundary rather than a Harness-owned discovery engine. External/domain discovery can surface transient candidate evidence to an Agent without silently mutating its durable WorkingSet; Harness proves the committed base view, bound Tool-observation provenance, exact Provider-visible model view, privacy-aware source materialization and the later Agent-selected successor transition. This supports keeping search/relevance policy outside generic Harness while retaining a narrow authority protocol between discovery evidence and cognition selection.
knownLimits: Harness still has no generic discovery engine, CandidateSet, Context Service, relevance ranking, RAG, Memory, summarization or automatic Context scheduler.

The experiments establish protocol/authority boundaries with deterministic/mock Provider behavior; they do not claim a real model will reliably recognize when to discover, formulate good searches or select epistemically good candidates.

Raw candidate interpretation and materialization policy are domain integration responsibilities. The proof uses test-specific bridge subclasses; no first-class recommended domain materialization hook was added in this slice.

The transient overlay rule admits an ordered subset of exact Tool Observation model projections. Harness proves provenance, not relevance or the semantic reason that a particular observation should be shown on a particular turn.
The validated integration expires an overlay when its source WorkingSet changes, but generic overlay lifetime/scheduling policy remains outside Harness and is not encoded as a new Context scheduler.

Overlay-backed durable cognition proof requires exact Provider request/result and Tool Observation content; metadata-only or other content policies that intentionally omit those bytes cannot reconstruct that exact cross-process proof without authorized rehydration.

Harness proves that a materialized pin resolves to an authorized exact source object; it does not prove that domain discovery transformed raw external data into the semantically correct source representation.
No Runtime, World, Finance or Host repository was changed. The existing Runtime search_workspace Tool was sufficient to test the boundary.
